name: Tanner Boser
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: Edmonton-based kickboxer (22-11-1, 5-6 UFC) and a small, fast heavyweight who out-lands most opponents but gets hurt by bigger punchers and controlled by wrestlers. Back in the UFC after a regional win, he lost his April return to Gokhan Saricam by R2 TKO and now fights at home.

how_they_fight.Striking: High-volume, accurate boxing with leg kicks (about 5 significant strikes a minute at 54%): out-landed Aleksa Camur 120-68 and even out-landed Saricam 60-57 before being knocked out. Blitzing combinations, and he has finishing power: knocked out Philipe Lins (R1), Raphael Pessoa (R2) and Ovince St. Preux (R2) in the UFC.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defensive only (about 0.4 takedowns per 15 minutes). His two split-decision losses came against grapplers: Ilir Latifi (6:38 control) and Rodrigo Nascimento (8:01 control).
how_they_fight.Defense: Takedown defense is solid on paper (71%) and he stuffed Saricam's shots, but his chin has become a concern: stopped three times, all by punches (Tim Hague R1 in 2015, Ion Cutelaba R1 in 2023, Saricam R2 in 2026). Saricam caught him with a straight right as he threw a leg kick.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Strong pace for a heavyweight; built for three or five rounds (three five-round decision wins and a R4 stoppage regionally). Finishes are spread out: 4 in R1, 6 in R2, 3 in R3, 1 in R4; 8 decision wins. Loses on scorecards more often than by stoppage (8 of 11 losses are decisions). When he loses early it's to a single big shot from a heavier hitter.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Smart volume striker who manages range, but tends to trade in the pocket and throw kicks within his opponent's punching range. Rotowire's view: too small for heavyweight and not quick enough for the best at 205.

patterns: Wins the volume battle; usually lands more than his opponent
Finishes spread across rounds (4 R1, 6 R2, 3 R3, 1 R4)
Loses decisions to grapplers who hold him down
Stopped three times by punches, two of them in his last three losses
concerns: Undersized heavyweight; recent knockout losses to heavy hitters (Cutelaba, Saricam)
Can be ridden out by heavier wrestlers
Age 35, with one UFC win since June 2021 (Camur)
keys_to_beat: Wrestle him and hold top position; he has no offense from his back
Counter his leg kicks with straight right hands
Use size and reach to keep him from closing the distance with combinations

news.text: Booked to face Jhonata Diniz at heavyweight on the Edmonton prelims, fighting at home in Alberta.
Lost his UFC return to Gokhan Saricam by R2 TKO (punches); our verified data and BJPenn list the time as 4:43. He weighed 244.5.
